task: Apply interest twice step by step: principal=1000, each step multiplies by 1025 then divides by 1000, truncating at EACH step (1000 -> 1025 -> 1050). Store the final integer 1050 as answer. When achieved, evaluate (final true).
lesson: Today I learned the step function's argument order (p 1025) causes truncation to occur before division, yielding 1050 instead of 1025.
